# VitaCoreX LLC — Complete Service Reference for LLMs
# https://vitacorexllc.com
# Generated: 2026-10-14 from the site service catalog (assets/data/vcx-catalog.json)

================================================================================
## Company
================================================================================

Company name: VitaCoreX LLC
Website: https://vitacorexllc.com
Phone: (888) 794-8292
Email: info@vitacorexllc.com
Location: Tampa, FL, United States
Founder: Steven Miller
Service languages: English, Russian, Spanish

VitaCoreX LLC helps private clients with documents, translations, online notarization, apostilles, individual tax returns, company formation, business plans, contracts and document tasks, and clerical immigration paperwork. A separate lane serves companies with small-claims document preparation and case support. Existing business clients can ask for recovery support, quoted individually.

It does not choose immigration forms or give eligibility advice. If a client needs a lawyer, VitaCoreX can pass a short summary to an independent licensed attorney only with the client's consent.

How prices work:
- All amounts are in USD and are service fees.
- "from" means a starting price; the final price is confirmed in a written quote before any payment.
- Government, state, USCIS, apostille and court fees, shipping and courier are separate and itemized.
- Paid work starts only after the client accepts a quote (or, for fixed-price services, pays the listed fee after the eligibility questions).
- Documents are exchanged through a private secure link. Do not send SSNs, tax forms or ID numbers through the website form or by email.

================================================================================
## Services and prices
================================================================================

### Documents & translations

#### Certified translation
- Price: $25 per 250 source words (one standard page)
- Birth certificates, diplomas, court and bank papers — complete translation with a signed translator certificate.
- Included: Complete translation of the document; Signed translator certificate of accuracy; Digital delivery (PDF); Check of language pair and legibility before you pay
- Not included / extra: Rush delivery; Rare language pairs and complex layout; Notarized translator affidavit (a separate notarial act); Printed copies and postage
- Next step: Send your language pair and approximate size. We confirm the word count, price and date, then you pay and upload through a private link.
- Page: https://vitacorexllc.com/translations.html

#### General translation
- Price: $0.10 per source word, $25 minimum order
- Letters, websites, business and personal texts that do not need a certificate.
- Included: Translation of the agreed text; One round of clarifications; Delivery in an editable file
- Not included / extra: Specialist subject matter (medical, technical, legal terminology); Rush delivery; Layout restoration
- Next step: Tell us the language pair, size and deadline. You receive a written quote before any payment.
- Page: https://vitacorexllc.com/translations.html

#### Online notarization
- Price: $25 — per notarial act
- Notarization over live video with a Florida Notary Public. You need a camera and a valid photo ID; if you are outside the U.S., we check first whether it is possible.
- Included: One online notarial act on your document; Identity verification on the online platform; Electronic notarized document; Session recording kept as required by Florida law
- Not included / extra: Each additional signature or act; Witnesses, if your document needs them; Printed copy and mailing
- Next step: Answer three quick questions, pay for the notarial act and pick a time. Your appointment is confirmed once the calendar email arrives.
- Page: https://vitacorexllc.com/online-notary.html

#### Apostille assistance
- Price: From $119 — final price after review (service fee for the first document)
- We find the office that apostilles your document for the country you need, prepare the request and track it.
- Included: Check of document origin, type and destination; Route to the correct state or federal authority; Preparation of the request and cover letter; Tracking and status updates
- Not included / extra: Government apostille fees; Shipping and courier; Certified copies, translation, embassy legalization
- Next step: Tell us where the document was issued and where it will be used. You get an itemized quote — service fee, government fee and shipping — before paying.
- Page: https://vitacorexllc.com/apostille.html

#### Official record retrieval
- Price: From $59 — final price after review (per record + agency fee)
- We order certified copies you are entitled to, such as birth or court records, and pass them straight to the apostille step if you need one.
- Included: Check that you are entitled to the record; Request typed for your signature or authorization; Order, tracking and receipt; Hand-off to translation, notarization or apostille only if required
- Not included / extra: Agency fees (e.g. a Florida birth certificate: $9); Shipping and courier; FBI background checks and out-of-state records: quote; Records you are not entitled to
- Next step: Tell us which record, where it was issued and which country needs it. We reply with the steps you actually need and the full cost.
- Page: https://vitacorexllc.com/apostille.html

### Taxes

#### Individual tax return
- Price: From $149 — final price after review (simple federal return, one tax year)
- Federal individual return (Form 1040), prepared by our accounting team after a short call about your situation.
- Included: A short talk about your tax year and income types; Preparation of a straightforward W-2 federal return; Review of the return with you before filing; Secure document exchange — never by email
- Not included / extra: State return; Self-employment, rental or foreign income; Amended or prior-year returns
- Next step: Tell us the tax year and type of return. We confirm what's included and the price, then send a secure link for your documents. Please don't send SSNs or tax forms through the website form.
- Page: https://vitacorexllc.com/tax-preparation.html

#### Self-employed tax return
- Price: From $249 — final price after review (federal return with one simple Schedule C)
- Federal return with one simple Schedule C for freelancers, contractors and sole proprietors.
- Included: Readiness check of your income and expense records; Federal return with one Schedule C; Review with you before filing
- Not included / extra: Bookkeeping cleanup; Several businesses, multi-state or foreign forms; State return
- Next step: Tell us the tax year and how you earn your income. After a quick look at your records, we confirm the price.
- Page: https://vitacorexllc.com/tax-preparation.html

#### State return add-on
- Price: From $49 — final price after review (one supported state, with a federal return)
- One state return prepared together with your federal return.
- Included: One resident state return; Prepared together with your federal return
- Not included / extra: Part-year, non-resident or several states
- Next step: Added to your federal tax request; the preparer confirms the price.
- Page: https://vitacorexllc.com/tax-preparation.html

### Court, immigration & contracts

#### Court name change (Florida, adult)
- Price: $199 + court fees — service fee; court fees go to the clerk
- Your Florida petition packet prepared from your answers, with county filing instructions and an after-court checklist.
- Included: Florida Supreme Court approved forms typed from your answers (petition and final judgment); Written filing instructions for your county, including fingerprints; Checklist of agencies to update after the judgment; Questionnaire and disclosure in English, Russian or Spanish
- Not included / extra: Court filing fee (about $400–$415 in Tampa-area counties); Background check and fingerprinting (about $50–$65); Certified copies of the judgment
- Next step: Answer a short questionnaire, sign the nonlawyer disclosure and pay the service fee. We prepare the packet and the filing instructions; you file it with your county clerk.
- Page: https://vitacorexllc.com/name-change.html

#### Court name change for a child or family (Florida)
- Price: From $249 — final price after review (starting price per petition)
- Petition packets for a minor child or a whole family, prepared from your answers; quoted after a short review.
- Included: Approved forms for minors or families typed from your answers; Filing instructions for your county
- Not included / extra: Court fees, background checks and certified copies; Consent or notice to the other parent where the law requires it
- Next step: Tell us who is changing their name and in which county. We confirm the scope and price before any work.
- Page: https://vitacorexllc.com/name-change.html

#### Records update after a name change
- Price: $69 — per person
- After a marriage, divorce or court order: Social Security and passport forms typed, a driver license checklist and letters to your banks.
- Included: Social Security form SS-5 typed; One passport form typed (DS-82, DS-5504 or DS-11); Florida driver license and ID checklist; Up to 10 name-change letters to banks, insurers and employers
- Not included / extra: Government fees (Social Security is free; passport fees per the State Department); Passport photos and postage; Certified copies of the marriage certificate or decree; Advice on which name to use
- Next step: Tell us how the name changed and which documents you hold. You pay, answer a short questionnaire, and receive the forms ready to sign.
- Page: https://vitacorexllc.com/name-change.html

#### Fee waiver application
- Price: $49 — per application
- Court or USCIS fee waiver forms typed from your written answers — one fixed price per application. The court or USCIS decides.
- Included: The fee-waiver form typed from your written answers; A list of the supporting documents the form asks for; Preparer section completed as the form requires
- Not included / extra: We do not advise whether you qualify or which basis to claim; Translations of supporting documents; The underlying court or USCIS application
- Next step: Tell us which court or USCIS form the waiver is for and pay the fixed fee. We send you a questionnaire to answer in writing and return the typed form for your signature.
- Page: https://vitacorexllc.com/fee-waiver.html

#### Immigration forms & documents
- Price: From $149 — final price after review (one simple form you have selected)
- Clerical preparation of a USCIS form that you or your attorney chose, plus organizing your supporting documents.
- Included: Typing the form from your answers; Completeness check against the form instructions; Organized document checklist and packet
- Not included / extra: USCIS filing fees; Translations of supporting documents; Choosing a form, eligibility advice or representation — not provided
- Next step: Tell us which form you are filing and your deadline. We confirm the scope and price before any work.
- Page: https://vitacorexllc.com/immigration-packet-review.html

#### Naturalization document support (N-400)
- Price: From $249 — final price after review (defined N-400 support scope)
- Administrative help with Form N-400: typing, completeness check and an organized document packet.
- Included: Form N-400 typed from your answers; Completeness check and document checklist; Organized packet ready for you to file
- Not included / extra: USCIS filing fee; Eligibility analysis, interview preparation or representation — not provided
- Next step: Send a short request. We confirm the scope and price; the decision to apply remains yours.
- Page: https://vitacorexllc.com/n-400-naturalization.html

#### Contracts & document support
- Price: From $99 — final price after review (starting price for a limited document task)
- Agreements, letters and forms you've chosen, prepared or put in order. We agree on the result before work starts.
- Included: Agreeing on the task and the result; Preparation or organization of the agreed document; One round of edits
- Not included / extra: Larger or multi-document tasks
- Next step: Describe the document you need. Before you pay, we confirm what we can prepare, what you will receive and the price.
- Page: https://vitacorexllc.com/contract-review-service.html

#### Civil dispute: summary to an independent attorney
- Price: No charge — no charge to you
- A dispute over money, a contract, housing or damage? With your consent we pass a short summary to an independent attorney who decides whether to contact you.
- Included: We turn your description into a short summary; With your written consent, we send it to an independent licensed attorney; You hear back from the attorney directly if they can help
- Not included / extra: The attorney decides whether to take the case and agrees any fees with you directly
- Next step: Describe the dispute and confirm your consent. We aim to pass the summary on within one business day; the attorney contacts you if they can help.
- Page: https://vitacorexllc.com/civil-case-referral.html

#### Ask about your situation
- Price: No charge — no charge to send a request
- Not sure which service fits? Describe the task — we tell you what we can do and what it costs.
- Included: We read your request and check how urgent it is; We suggest a matching service and price; If you need a lawyer, we can pass a short summary to an independent attorney — only with your consent
- Not included / extra: This is not a free legal consultation; Paid work starts only after you accept a quote
- Next step: We reply with the suitable service, price or next step.
- Page: https://vitacorexllc.com/request.html?service=legal_request

### Start and run a business

#### Company formation
- Price: $99 + state fee — service fee + state filing fee
- We prepare and submit the formation filing for the state and entity type you have chosen.
- Included: Name availability check; Articles prepared and submitted; Filing confirmation and organized records; One clerical correction if the state requests it
- Not included / extra: State filing fee (paid at cost); Registered agent, annual reports, licenses; Tax elections
- Next step: Choose the state and entity type, pay the service fee, and we confirm the state fee before filing. No subscription.
- Page: https://vitacorexllc.com/llc-formation-florida.html

#### Company formation + EIN
- Price: $199 + state fee — service fee + state filing fee
- Everything in Company formation, plus help applying for your EIN and an organized starter file.
- Included: Everything in Company formation; EIN application assistance (the IRS does not charge for an EIN); Organized formation records
- Not included / extra: State filing fee (paid at cost); Registered agent, renewals, bank account opening
- Next step: Choose the state and entity type, pay the service fee, and we confirm the state fee before filing.
- Page: https://vitacorexllc.com/llc-formation-florida.html

#### Florida annual report filing
- Price: $79 + state fee — one entity, one year + state fee
- We check your Sunbiz record, type the annual report with any address or manager changes, file it and send you the filed copy.
- Included: Check of your Sunbiz record before filing; Address, officer, manager and registered agent updates typed into the report; Filing and the filed PDF; A reminder before next year’s window
- Not included / extra: Florida state fee: $138.75 for an LLC, $150 for a corporation; State late fee of $400 after May 1; Reinstatement after dissolution (quote); Tax returns are a separate service
- Next step: Send the company name or Sunbiz document number. We confirm what changes, you pay, and we file. You can also file yourself at sunbiz.org and pay only the state fee.
- Page: https://vitacorexllc.com/business-filings.html

#### Yearly company upkeep (Florida)
- Price: $119 + state fee — per entity, per year + state fees
- The annual report plus reminders, one certificate of status and one mid-year update. Renews only when you say so.
- Included: Annual report filing; Reminders in January, March and April; One certificate of status after filing; One amended annual report if your data changes
- Not included / extra: All state fees; No automatic renewal: each year needs your new consent; Registered agent service; Tax returns
- Next step: Choose the plan, confirm the company details and pay for one year. We handle the report and remind you before each step.
- Page: https://vitacorexllc.com/business-filings.html

#### Fictitious name (DBA) registration, Florida
- Price: $69 + state fee — one registration + state fee
- Register a trade name for your business in Florida, valid for five years.
- Included: Sunbiz record or name search; Form typed from your written answers; Filing or order and tracking; The filed document as a PDF
- Not included / extra: Florida state fee: $50; Newspaper notice in your county, as the law requires (newspaper’s price); Trademark searches or opinions
- Next step: Tell us the company and what you need. We confirm the state fee and the details, you pay, and we file.
- Page: https://vitacorexllc.com/business-filings.html

#### Articles of amendment, Florida
- Price: $89 + state fee — one amendment + state fee
- Change your company’s name, address or other recorded details, typed exactly as you decide.
- Included: Sunbiz record or name search; Form typed from your written answers; Filing or order and tracking; The filed document as a PDF
- Not included / extra: Florida state fee: $25 for an LLC, $35 for a corporation; Postage or courier (Florida accepts amendments by mail); Advice on ownership changes, mergers or conversions
- Next step: Tell us the company and what you need. We confirm the state fee and the details, you pay, and we file.
- Page: https://vitacorexllc.com/business-filings.html

#### Certificate of status (good standing), Florida
- Price: $29 + state fee — one certificate + state fee
- The official certificate that your company is active, often asked for by banks and partners.
- Included: Sunbiz record or name search; Form typed from your written answers; Filing or order and tracking; The filed document as a PDF
- Not included / extra: Florida state fee: $5 for an LLC, $8.75 for a corporation; Apostille for use abroad (separate service)
- Next step: Tell us the company and what you need. We confirm the state fee and the details, you pay, and we file.
- Page: https://vitacorexllc.com/business-filings.html

#### Certified copy of company documents, Florida
- Price: $39 + state fee — one order + state fee
- Certified copies of your articles or other filed records, ordered from the state.
- Included: Sunbiz record or name search; Form typed from your written answers; Filing or order and tracking; The filed document as a PDF
- Not included / extra: Florida state fee: $30 for an LLC; $8.75 and up for a corporation; Postage or courier; Apostille (separate service)
- Next step: Tell us the company and what you need. We confirm the state fee and the details, you pay, and we file.
- Page: https://vitacorexllc.com/business-filings.html

#### Company filings in other states
- Price: Individual quote — quoted per operation and state
- Annual reports, DBAs, amendments and certificates outside Florida, where the state accepts them online or by mail.
- Included: Check of that state’s current fees and rules; Written quote before any payment
- Not included / extra: That state’s fees; Newspaper publication where required
- Next step: Tell us the state and the operation. We reply with the state fee, our fee and what we need from you.
- Page: https://vitacorexllc.com/business-filings.html

#### Business plan
- Price: From $499 — final price after review (defined basic plan)
- A plan built from your questionnaire: business model, market summary with sources and a simple financial outline.
- Included: Questionnaire and one working call; Business model and market summary with sources; Assumption-based financial outline; Editable file and one revision
- Not included / extra: Investor, SBA or visa-specific plans; Paid market data and complex financial models
- Next step: Tell us what the plan is for and your deadline. We confirm scope and price in writing.
- Page: https://vitacorexllc.com/business-plans.html

### For companies: small claims

#### Small-claims case packet
- Price: from $199 — final price after review (one eligible case, one defendant)
- An organized case file for one claim against one defendant: chronology, amounts, exhibits and prepared forms where permitted.
- Included: Case intake and document review; Chronology and amount calculation; Indexed exhibit packet; Preparation of forms where this is permitted in your state
- Not included / extra: Court filing fees and service of process; Court appearance, appeals and enforcement — not provided; Additional defendants
- Next step: Check your case: state, court and claim basics. We confirm what we can do in that state and send a quote.
- Page: https://vitacorexllc.com/small-claims-documentation.html

#### Small-claims preparation & case support
- Price: from $399 — final price after review (one case, one defendant, first 30 days)
- The case packet plus filing coordination where permitted, docket follow-up and status updates for 30 days.
- Included: Everything in the case packet; Filing coordination where permitted; Docket follow-up and milestone updates; 30-day service window
- Not included / extra: Court fees and service of process; Representation, appeals, enforcement — not provided; Continuation after 30 days by separate agreement
- Next step: Start with the case check. We confirm the permitted scope for your state and court before a quote.
- Page: https://vitacorexllc.com/small-claims-documentation.html

#### Recovery support for existing clients
- Price: individual quote
- An additional option for current business clients, quoted individually.
- Included: Review of your current matter; Individual written quote
- Not included / extra: Available to existing business clients only
- Next step: Send your client reference; your manager replies with options.
- Page: https://vitacorexllc.com/net-recovery.html

Small claims for companies — scope notes:
- Each case starts with a case check (state, court, entity type, claim basics). The permitted scope for that state and court is confirmed before a quote.
- New York is not offered for this B2B product (company policy).
- Court filing fees and service of process are separate. Court appearance, representation, appeals and enforcement are not provided.

## FAQ
================================================================================

Q: What is VitaCoreX LLC?
A: A Tampa, Florida document and case-management company: court paperwork and Florida name changes, small-claims cases for companies by the hour under a power of attorney, company formation and annual filings, individual tax returns; plus certified translations, apostilles and online notarization.

Q: How much does online notarization cost?
A: $25 per notarial act. Additional signatures or acts, witnesses, and a printed copy with mailing are extra.

Q: How much does a certified translation cost?
A: $25 per 250 source words (one standard page). The word count, price and date are confirmed before payment.

Q: How much does an individual tax return cost?
A: From $149 for a simple federal return for one tax year — final price after review. A state return is an add-on from $49; a self-employed return with one simple Schedule C starts from $249.

Q: How much does apostille assistance cost?
A: From $119 service fee for the first document. Government apostille fees and shipping are separate and itemized in the quote.

Q: How much does company formation cost?
A: $99 + state filing fee for the state and entity type you have chosen, or $199 + state filing fee with EIN application assistance. No subscription.

Q: Does VitaCoreX help with immigration forms?
A: Yes, clerically: typing a USCIS form you or your adviser have chosen, a completeness check and an organized document packet (from $149), and N-400 document support (from $249). Choosing a form, eligibility advice and representation are not provided. USCIS fees are separate.

Q: Can I ask a question before choosing a service?
A: Yes. Sending a request through "Ask about your situation" is free of charge. It is not a free legal consultation; VitaCoreX replies with a matching service and price.

Q: Does VitaCoreX handle small claims for companies?
A: Yes, as document preparation and case support: a case packet from $199 or preparation & case support for the first 30 days from $399, one case and one defendant. Court fees are separate; no court appearance or representation. The product is not offered in New York.

Q: What languages does VitaCoreX work in?
A: English, Russian and Spanish. Translations for other language pairs are quoted on request, subject to availability.

Q: How do I contact VitaCoreX?
A: Phone (888) 794-8292, email info@vitacorexllc.com, or the request form at https://vitacorexllc.com/request.html.
